faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What you need to know about delivering with Fawran
faq.a1: Fawran is an Egyptian delivery app based in Suez. It connects individuals and shops with nearby couriers to move orders and goods from one place to another. Fawran is not a shipping or postal company — it is an intermediary platform linking senders with approved couriers.
faq.a2: We currently serve the city of Suez and Suez Governorate. We are expanding to other Egyptian cities over time, and any new coverage appears in the app as soon as it goes live.
faq.q3: How do I order a courier?
faq.a3: Download the app and create an account with your mobile number, then create an order with the pickup address, delivery address, and package details. The nearest available courier accepts it, and you can follow them on the map until they arrive.
faq.a4: The delivery fee is calculated from the distance and the order details, and it is shown to you in the app before you confirm — no surprises afterwards.
faq.q5: How do I track my order?
faq.a5: Once a courier accepts your order you can see their location on the map in real time, and you get a notification with every status update. You can also send a tracking link to whoever is waiting for the delivery, with no app install needed.
faq.a6: Yes. Cancelling is free while no courier has accepted the order yet. After a courier accepts it, a cancellation fee may apply. If something is damaged or lost through a courier's fault, we review the order and resolve it within 7 working days.
faq.q7: Is anything prohibited from being sent?
faq.a7: Yes. Anything unlawful under Egyptian law is prohibited, including narcotics, weapons and ammunition, hazardous or explosive materials, and any goods requiring special permits you do not hold. Where we suspect a violation we stop the order and notify the authorities.
faq.q8: How do I work as a Fawran courier?
faq.a8: If you are 18 or older and have your own transport, get in touch through the contact form on this site. Couriers use in-app points to accept deliveries, purchased through the payment methods available in the app.

legal.privacy_intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what information Fawran collects, how we use it, and how we protect it.
legal.privacy_meta_description: How Fawran collects, uses, and protects personal information for clients and couriers in Suez, Egypt.
legal.s1_body: We collect information you provide when you register, such as your name and phone number; location data needed to fulfill orders; order and financial transaction history; and device information such as operating system and a push-notification identifier. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.s2_body: We use your data to fulfill delivery orders and match you with a nearby courier, send notifications about your order status, improve the product, protect accounts and detect fraud, and comply with applicable legal requirements in Egypt.
legal.s3_body: We do not sell your personal data. We share the minimum necessary with: the courier assigned to your order (name, phone number, and address only); electronic payment providers to process transactions; mapping and crash-reporting providers that help operate the app; and competent authorities when required by law.
legal.s4_body: The app uses location services to set pickup and drop-off points, and to track an active delivery in real time. Couriers who are fulfilling an order may share location while the app is in the background so the client can follow the delivery. You can turn location off in your phone settings; some features will then be unavailable.
legal.s5_body: We send notifications about order updates and important account notices. You can manage notification preferences in your device settings.
legal.s6_body: We use encryption in transit to protect your data. Access to sensitive data is limited to staff who need it for their role.
legal.s7_body: We keep your account data while the account is active. After you delete your account, we retain order and financial records as needed for legal and accounting purposes, with personal identifiers removed or replaced so they no longer identify you.
legal.s8_body: You may access the personal data we hold, request correction of inaccurate data, and request deletion of your account from inside the Fawran app. To exercise these rights, use Delete Account in the app, or contact us through the contact form on this website.
legal.s9_body: Fawran is not directed at people under 18, and we do not knowingly collect data from them. If we learn that a minor has registered, we will delete the account.
legal.s10_body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes in the app. Continued use of the app after an update means you accept the revised policy.
legal.s11_body: For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, use the contact form on this website. A dedicated privacy mailbox will be published here once it is in service.
legal.terms_intro: Please read these terms carefully before using Fawran. Using the app means you agree to the following.
legal.terms_meta_description: Terms of use for the Fawran delivery platform in Suez, Egypt.
legal.t1_body: By using Fawran, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, stop using the app. We may update these terms; continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.
legal.t2_body: Fawran is a smart delivery platform that lets individuals and businesses send their own items from one place to another in Egypt. Fawran is not a shipping company or a postal service; it is an intermediary that connects senders with approved couriers.
legal.t3_body: You must be 18 or older to register. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your login details confidential. You are responsible for activity on your account.
legal.t4_body: It is forbidden to send anything that violates Egyptian law or public morals, including narcotics, weapons and ammunition, hazardous or explosive materials, and goods that require special permits without those permits. If we suspect a violation, Fawran may stop the order and notify the competent authorities.
legal.t5_body: Delivery fees are calculated according to distance and the details of the order. Couriers use points in the app to accept deliveries; points are purchased through the payment methods available in the app. Prices may change without prior notice.
legal.t6_body: A client may cancel an order free of charge before a courier accepts it. After acceptance, a cancellation fee may apply. In documented cases of damage or loss caused by the courier, Fawran will review the request and decide within 7 business days.
legal.t7_body: You are responsible for providing a correct delivery address and for communicating with the courier. You are also responsible for adequate packaging of fragile items. Fawran is not responsible for damage caused by inadequate packaging.
legal.t8_body: Fawran is not responsible for purchase-on-behalf orders (buying goods on the client's behalf). The client should confirm they have received any cash from the courier and follow the courier on tracking while the order is in progress.
legal.t9_body: Registered couriers must provide accurate identity information, meet service standards, and deal with clients professionally. Fawran may suspend or close a courier account that breaches these standards.
legal.t10_body: All app content — design, logos, text, and code — is owned by Fawran. Copying or using any of it without prior written permission is prohibited.
legal.t11_body: These terms are governed by Egyptian law. Egyptian courts have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.
legal.t12_body: For questions about these terms, use the contact form on this website.
legal.support_intro: Fawran support is available through the contact form on this website and, for signed-in users, through the support options inside the app.
legal.support_meta_description: How to contact Fawran support in Suez, Egypt.
legal.support_how_body: Use the contact form on this website. Signed-in users can also contact support from the Account screen in the Fawran app when a support number is configured. A public support email will be added here once the company mailbox is in service.
